title: Logged model search filter_string metric comparisons: join a distinct model_id subquery, never whole metric rows
answers: search_logged_models returns fewer models than max_results on the first page when filter_string has metrics.<name> comparisons
Logged model search pagination stops early and drops matching models when a model logged the same metric at several steps, runs or datasets
Where is the metric comparison in a logged model filter_string joined to the model query?
body:
Path: Logged model search with a filter_string containing metric comparisons (e.g. metrics.accuracy > 0, plus param, tag and dataset filters) passes through mlflow/store/tracking/sqlalchemy_store.py:SqlAlchemyStore._apply_filter_string_datasets_search_logged_models, which builds one non_attr_filters subquery per comparison before the model query is paginated with OFFSET/LIMIT.
Rule: For a metric comparison, select only SqlLoggedModelMetric.model_id with .distinct() as the subquery (session.query(SqlLoggedModelMetric.model_id).filter(*metric_filters).distinct().subquery()), so the join is one-to-at-most-one per model. Selecting whole metric rows duplicated a model once per matching (metric_step, run_id, dataset) row, and the duplicates were removed only after SQL LIMIT had counted them.
Symptom: A search_logged_models page with max_results=N came back with fewer than N models even though more matched, and the next_page_token was not issued when it should have been, so later matching models were silently skipped.
Constraints: Applies to metric comparisons only. Param and tag subqueries are intentionally unchanged because their primary keys (model_id, param_key) and (model_id, tag_key) plus the pinned key match at most one row per model. Dataset-only filters already select distinct model_id. The fix does not change filter semantics, only the row count seen by LIMIT.
Applies: SQL tracking store search_logged_models filter_string handling for metrics.<name> comparisons, when results are paginated; not the order_by path, which has its own per-model ranking subquery.
applies: SQL tracking store filter_string metric comparisons in search_logged_models; any new per-entity filter subquery joined into a paginated query should select only the parent key with distinct.
says: Filtering models by metric value shows fewer items per page than requested.
Model search with a metric filter cuts off without offering a next page.
Models evaluated across multiple steps disappear from search results when filtering by score.
First page of model search returns too few results despite matching metric thresholds.
search: In SqlAlchemyStore._apply_filter_string_datasets_search_logged_models, metric comparison subqueries must select only distinct SqlLoggedModelMetric.model_id rather than full metric rows. Selecting full rows caused models with multiple steps, runs, or datasets to duplicate before pagination LIMIT, silently truncating search_logged_models pages and dropping next_page_token. This applies strictly to SQL tracking store metric comparisons in search_logged_models, excluding param and tag subqueries, dataset-only filters, and the order_by path.
